While speaking to reporters at the White House, President Trump weighed in on the Pentagon's decision to livestream the upcoming firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan. Trump said that he "absolutely" approved of the broadcast and described the shooter as "totally nuts." "I really don't care how he goes, as long as he goes, and I think that the death penalty is a very worthy way of going for him," Trump said.

I just landed in Africa and I’m learning about traditional ways people have cared for and styled their hair for generations. This time I tried otjize, the red ochre-based mixture traditionally associated with the Himba people, on my type 4 hair. My curls actually turned out way better than I expected 😭 I can’t wait to keep traveling, learning about different hair traditions around the world, and trying new ways to style and care for my natural hair. #creatorsearchinsights #hairtok #fyp #viral #type4hair

The Patient Zero video is finally out in the world! Getting to work with Emmanuel Lubezki was something out of a dream sequence, and I learned so much from getting to watch his genius in action. I want to thank Dakota and Colin for trusting me with their time, taste, and talent (Giggling with your friend because you’re twinning for an entire shoot was a new and truly delightful experience). And Colin’s turn as a villain is even more impressive when you get to be around him. He’s an absolute light and as kind as they come. Cara, thank you for agreeing to play the lusty other woman. That’s what friends are for? With the Patient Zero video, I got to explore the cinematic and literary genres I love so much. I wanted to incorporate elements of gothic ghost stories, true crime, psychological thrillers all in a setting I hadn’t really shot in much. The house was a metaphor for the coldness of a relationship that’s faded and atrophied. Thank you to Ethan Tobman for your insightful production design, and bringing that feeling to life. My editor Chancler Haynes has outdone himself. And lastly, thank you to the VMAs for giving us a World Premiere at the place where celebrating music videos became a thing. And so much love for you guys, always.
